target_profile.system_boundary: Captured Go raft library, including RawNode/Node, log/storage interface, membership changer, quorum and progress logic. Network, actual durable device and user state machine are caller-owned; in-repository orchestration remains applicable.
protocol_contexts: Raft group, term, role, log term/index and active voter configuration
Synchronous Ready/Advance or asynchronous storage responses
ownership: Node serializes via event loop; RawNode requires serialized caller access.
Caller provides ticks, transport, persistence, committed-entry application and configuration application.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Replication progress and voter aggregation establish commitment; read-index requests separately qualify a read frontier through heartbeat support.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Term/vote elections acquire authority; term dispatch, quorum checks and leadership transfer change it while preserving committed log history.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Snapshots and startup reconstruct eligible participation from retained committed history and configuration; retry/probe paths repair lagging replicas.
Applied configuration entries and ConfState restoration define incoming/outgoing voters, learners and automatic exit policy.
Ready supplies eligible committed work; caller application completions advance the applied frontier and may initiate automatic configuration exit.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: Caller storage persists HardState, entries and snapshots; the implementation orders dependent messages and reconciles completion against current context.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Node serializes state-machine operations and RawNode exposes direct serialized integration. Callers own transport, ticks, storage and state-machine effects; proposal acceptance is not commitment.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term, local log, configured voter progress
behaviors.trigger: Proposal admission or qualified MsgAppResp / MsgApp
implementation_guards: Reject proposals during transfer or when leader is removed; constrain pending configuration proposals.
Follower requires matching previous entry; cannot overwrite committed entries.
Commit needs configured majority support and a matching current-term entry.
writes: Assign term and index; append unstable entries; update peer Match/Next and committed index.
external_effects: Broadcast append after proposal or newly established commitment. MsgAppResp commitment path releases queued reads; this is not an effect of every maybeCommit caller.
Reject hints repair divergent tails; heartbeat replies resume probes and flow control; missing history switches to snapshots.
async_boundaries: Self and peer append acknowledgements depend on storage completion via B-ready.

cross_activity_effects.A5: Makes entries eligible for application after the Ready admission constraints.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.Step, campaign, state transitions and reset
behaviors.protocol_context: Term, vote, leader identity and current configuration
behaviors.trigger: Election tick, campaign, vote response, higher-term message or CheckQuorum
implementation_guards: Campaign requires local voter eligibility and no unapplied committed configuration change.
Vote qualification checks prior vote/leader and candidate log freshness; pre-vote and lease checks have explicit exceptions.
Only matching candidacy response type is polled; quorum decides election.
writes: Reset progress, votes, readOnly and transfer target on role transition; change persistent term/vote where required; leader appends empty current-term entry.
important_branches: Ordinary stale messages are discarded. Stale storage append responses do not stabilize entries, but snapshot completion still advances application.
PendingReadIndexMessages is retained across reset; later release samples a fresh committed index and safe-read quorum context. This does not itself prove completion.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Invalidates old volatile replication/election support while preserving committed log prefix.
cross_activity_effects.A4: New leader delays configuration proposals behind the preexisting log tail.

behaviors.protocol_context: Current leader and eligible nonlearner transfer target
behaviors.trigger: TransferLeader request, matching append acknowledgement, or election-timeout ticks
implementation_guards: Ignore learner target and self transfer; require target progress.
writes: Set target and reset electionElapsed; abort clears only leadTransferee.
external_effects: Catch up target or send TimeoutNow; proposals are rejected during transfer.
important_branches: Timeout abort keeps the existing leader; it does not directly call appliedTo or append an entry.
Successful transfer leads to a new campaign and new leader entry.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Can suppress an automatic leave proposal attempted by application completion.

behaviors.protocol_context: Applied configuration entry and active incoming/outgoing voter sets
implementation_guards: Simple changes alter at most one voter; joint entry requires nonempty nonjoint base.
Outgoing voters retain progress; demotion to learner is staged until joint exit.
Proposal admission serializes pending changes and requires exit before another joint change.
writes: Install incoming/outgoing sets, learners, progress and AutoLeave. Joint exit clears outgoing set and AutoLeave.
external_effects: Recompute commitment and broadcast/probe under new configuration; abort transfer to removed target.
important_branches: switchToConfig commitment advancement broadcasts but does not directly release pending reads.
Removed/demoted leader steps down only when configured to do so.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Changes which Match/vote support can decide commitment or elections.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Changes campaign eligibility and leadership retention.

behaviors.execution_owner: raft.appliedTo, appliedSnap and raftLog application accounting
behaviors.protocol_context: Committed entry index, applied index, current role and pendingConfIndex
behaviors.trigger: MsgStorageApplyResp with entries or snapshot completion
writes: Advance applied monotonically and account outstanding application bytes.
implementation_guards: Automatic exit attempted only while AutoLeave, leader, and applied reaches pendingConfIndex.
external_effects: Attempt zero ConfChangeV2 proposal through Step; success appends via B-replicate, transfer rejection leaves configuration joint.
important_branches: Empty apply result does not call appliedTo. Later real application completion can retry; arbitrary Ready/Advance without committed entries does not imply this effect.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Consumes automatic-joint configuration to initiate exit.
cross_activity_effects.A1: Queues the exit proposal through ordinary leader proposal admission.

unknowns: Does a failed transfer consume the final application trigger with no later retry despite an otherwise idle healthy quorum?

behaviors.execution_owner: RawNode Ready/acceptReady/Advance and caller storage worker
behaviors.protocol_context: Serialized RawNode; synchronous or asynchronous storage policy
behaviors.trigger: Ready consumption and subsequent caller completion
implementation_guards: Network Step rejects local messages from ordinary peers and responses from unknown peers.
Async append responses use issuing term plus entry term/index; stale append completion cannot truncate a replaced unstable log.
writes: Accepted Ready advances delivered unstable/applying frontiers and drains outbound queues.
durable_effects: Actual durable writes belong to caller; msgsAfterAppend cannot be released before corresponding writes.
external_effects: Synchronous Advance steps captured local responses; async storage workers return supplied responses.
async_boundaries: Same local worker messages must be processed reliably in order; append/apply targets may proceed independently.
Changed HardState supplies fresh-term stabilization response while unstable entries remain.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Durability qualifies votes and append acknowledgements, including self support.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Only actual entry/snapshot completion invokes application accounting.

behaviors.protocol_context: Storage InitialState and retained log or received snapshot
implementation_guards: Snapshot index must exceed committed; restore requires follower and recipient membership.
Matching snapshot term/index can fast-forward commitment without replacing log/configuration.
writes: Full restore replaces unstable log and reconstructs configuration including AutoLeave; startup loads HardState, caller Applied and enters follower.

cross_activity_effects.A2: Restores participation context without preserving volatile leader authority.
cross_activity_effects.A4: Reconstructs joint sets and AutoLeave from ConfState.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Snapshot completion carries committed state independent of issuing term.

behaviors.protocol_context: Single event loop around a RawNode
behaviors.trigger: Proposal, received message, tick, ApplyConfChange, Ready, Advance or Stop
implementation_guards: Synchronous Ready delivery awaits Advance before next batch; other events still run while Advance is outstanding.
Message entry filters local types and unknown response sources.
writes: Channel ownership serializes raft state mutations.
external_effects: Proposal return is admission/processing, not commitment. Stop joins run via done.
async_boundaries: RawNode itself is thread-unsafe; direct caller must serialize it.
Caller applies committed configuration entries through ApplyConfChange; Node does not autonomously execute application code.

cross_activity_effects.A5: Caller application and completion order determines when B-apply runs.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Transfer/other messages may legally interleave before outstanding application completion.

behaviors.execution_owner: ReadIndex admission, releasePendingReadIndexMessages and heartbeat quorum handling
behaviors.protocol_context: Read request context, leader term and committed index
behaviors.trigger: ReadIndex request, first-term commit release, heartbeat response
implementation_guards: Non-singleton defers requests until a current-term entry is committed.
Safe reads require heartbeat-context acknowledgements from configured quorum.
Caller differentiates results using request context.
external_effects: Return ReadState locally or send MsgReadIndexResp; application must use the read index.
important_branches: Deferred requests retained across reset are re-entered with fresh committed index and safe-read acknowledgements, rather than reusing old readOnly quorum support.
unknowns: Can configuration-triggered first-term commitment strand deferred reads without another increasing Match response?

facts.meaning: The local log committed frontier covers an immutable prefix established by qualified leader support, received leader commitment bounded by matched history, or restored committed snapshot/history.
facts.validity_context: Local term changes preserve the established prefix; application completion is a separate frontier.
facts.durability: Persisted HardState/log or snapshot through caller storage contract; in-memory frontier may advance before local storage completes.
facts.recovery: newRaft loads retained HardState and log; restore can establish a newer committed snapshot prefix.

facts.meaning: The installed local configuration is joint and marked for implementation-initiated automatic exit; this alone does not assert that an exit entry has been proposed, committed or applied.

identity.configuration: incoming and outgoing voter sets plus learners and staged learners

facts.validity_context: Active configuration after applying an implicit joint entry or reconstructing a joint ConfState; it persists through leader term changes until configuration replacement or joint exit.
facts.durability: Serialized in ConfState; entry/snapshot persistence and replay are caller duties.
facts.recovery: confchange.Restore reconstructs outgoing then incoming configuration and restores AutoLeave.
unknowns: Automatic-exit retry after a transfer abort with no remaining application completion.

surfaces.reason: Distinct commit consumer effects retained; legal first-term-commit history and release alternatives remain unresolved.
Safe read backbone inspected; lease-mode fault/timing contract needs deeper review.
Inspected loop contains uncertainty about proposal admission after removal and leader changes; no legal counterexample established.

formation.explanation: A leader owns proposal sequencing in its term. Proposals become indexed unstable entries; follower prefix matching and durable acknowledgements qualify per-peer Match support. Configured majorities, including both halves while joint, yield a candidate committed index that can advance only at a current-term entry. Followers consume bounded leader commitment; Ready propagates committed entries to caller application. Rejection hints, probe/heartbeat retries and snapshots recover lagging participation. Application and durable completion are distinct from protocol commitment.

context.explanation: Campaign admission depends on voter eligibility and applied committed configuration changes. Term/vote and log freshness qualify votes; configured quorums acquire leadership. Higher-term dispatch and quorum checks remove authority; transfer temporarily rejects proposals and asks a caught-up voter to campaign, with timeout abort. Reset clears volatile support, readOnly acknowledgements and transfer state but retains committed history. New leaders append a current-term entry. Stale ordinary replies are ignored; stale append storage completions cannot trim new unstable context, while snapshot completion remains meaningful across terms.

connection.explanation: The active configuration determines whose votes and Match positions form support. Configuration application can reinterpret existing progress and recompute commitment; election admission waits for committed configuration application. Completed decisions survive term changes and constrain new leaders through log freshness and immutable committed prefixes. Ready/storage ordering prevents votes and append support escaping before persistence. Automatic joint exit consumes installed AutoLeave configuration only at an application-completion trigger under leader authority, and routes its proposal through the same transfer admission guard as client work. Retained pre-commit read requests are later qualified afresh, not satisfied from discarded readOnly support.
